question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping’s entrenched position as CCP general secretary, state president, and Central Military Commission chairman drives the 95.3% “No” consensus, with analysts citing his ongoing public diplomacy, policy leadership, and elite appointments through mid-2026. The 20th Central Committee remains dominated by his allies, military purges have not produced visible fractures, and no viable successor has been elevated ahead of the 21st Party Congress scheduled for late 2027. Trader pricing reflects the absence of credible elite defections, health disclosures, or institutional challenges capable of forcing removal before the December 31, 2026 resolution deadline. Low-probability disruptions such as an acute medical event or sudden leadership coalition could still shift outcomes, though current evidence indicates few structural pathways exist.
